scope: Read-only audit of existing Burst valid naturally exited events; no trade-engine invocation, no new simulation, no rule changes. Observed extremal cases are intentionally selected for error detection, not representative performance estimates.
selection_rule: For net_r, peak_r, net_return independently take highest3 and lowest3; deterministic tie break ascending event_id; deduplicate union. BTC/ETH remain eligible for this mechanical extreme audit and are identified by symbol.
suspicious_jump_threshold: source timeframe close/previousclose or open/previousclose >=2 or <=0.5, or high/low>=2; entire signal-minus20 through exit window examined

rave_raw_detail.price_unit_observation: Original RAVEUSDT monthly ZIP already contains the same prices, with no 1000 scaling applied by this pipeline. No 100% adjacent 15m/1H discontinuity observed in held window. Historical contract multiplier/specification changes have not been independently authenticated.

limitations: Checks establish agreement with archived Binance native candles and the frozen hypothetical execution algebra, not proof of actual fills or a price history unchanged by Binance.

The 20bp cost is fixed on entry notional; it does not model both-leg exchange fees that scale with changing exit notional, funding, spread, market impact, liquidity limits, partial fills or exchange outages.
Historical lot size, tick schedule, contract multiplier and exchange migration/re-denomination schedules have not been independently authenticated; current catalog tick is used in the frozen model.
Stop-hit candles are conservatively excluded from peak R, but OHLC cannot establish exact intrabar stop fill time or slippage.
Very wide initial stops in tail cases are part of the frozen signal-stop construction; -1R may represent a 60%-67% loss of position notional, not the account equity when position sizing limits risk.
Highest-return extreme RAVE dominates potential tail conclusions; performance without that symbol/trade must be reported, and these handpicked extremes cannot establish broad generalization.
XAUT is a gold-backed token in current COIN metadata, so the nominal altcoin pool has heterogeneous instruments; BTC/ETH are already separate diagnostics.
